fields.title: Quiz APP
fields.description:
AI Quiz Master is a dynamic quiz web application where users can generate quizzes on any topic using AI. The system supports user authentication, stores quiz history, and provides performance tracking.

This project combines AI, backend development, and database management to create an interactive learning platform.

fields.title: Student_portal
fields.description: A web-based Student Portal designed to provide students with easy access to Previous Year Question Papers. The platform allows students to search, filter, view, and download papers based on subjects, semesters, branches, and academic years. It is built using Django and Python with a focus on providing a simple, organized, and user-friendly experience for exam preparation.

fields.title: TwaCare
fields.description:
TwaCare is an AI-powered web application that helps users identify their skin concerns and provides personalized skincare suggestions. Users can input their skin type and issues, and the system intelligently generates recommendations.

This project combines AI and Web Development to create a practical and user-friendly solution.

fields.title: ECO-Lens
fields.description:
AI INTEGRATED SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT 🌱 EcoLens – AI Powered Sustainability Scanner

EcoLens is a web application that helps users understand the environmental impact of everyday products using AI. Users can analyze products and get insights on eco-friendly usage, disposal methods, reuse ideas, and sustainability scores.

fields.title: Wandr
fields.description: Wandr is an AI-powered luxury travel planning application that creates personalized, day-by-day travel itineraries based on the user's destination, trip type, budget, interests, desired feeling, travel pace, and energy level. The application combines a premium dark glassmorphism interface with AI-powered travel recommendations to provide travelers with experiences tailored to how they want to travel, rather than generic destination suggestions.
